description: This Python script initializes a SQLite database by creating tables, inserting initial data, checking database accessibility, saving connection info, and setting environment variables for external tools. It sets up a minimal database schema with 'app_info' and 'users' tables and provides user guidance on accessing the database.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main procedural logic that initializes the database, creates tables, inserts data, and outputs setup information.
